<translate>
'''Babidi''' (Master Babidi) waits in [[Special:MyLanguage/Babidi's Spaceship|Babidi's Spaceship]] in the mountains of [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. He teaches no skills: his one service brands Evil-aligned players with the '''Majin mark''', a permanent power boost.
</translate>

<translate>
== Location ==
</translate>
<translate>
Babidi waits in [[Special:MyLanguage/Babidi's Spaceship|Babidi's Spaceship]], which generates once per world in the mountains. Capsule Corp Assistants sell a map to it at trade tier 5 (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Babidi's Spaceship#Finding it|Babidi's Spaceship]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Receive the Mark ==
</translate>
{{See also|Majin Mark|Effects}}
<translate>
* Babidi gives you the '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Majin Mark|Majin mark]]''' only if your [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|alignment]] is below 39. At 39 or higher he refuses.
* The mark is a '''permanent power boost''' (×1.3 by default) that also puts the Majin "M" on your character. Once marked, it stays with you permanently. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Effects|Effects]].
* The option is locked once you already carry the mark.
</translate>
